caption:
The fork passed handle first

She turned the fork around before she passed it, handle first, the way you do when you want the other person to take it easily.

The handle end toward them means they take it without thinking, and nobody grabs the wrong side.

For whoever hands things over handle first.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A room with a long table. A ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left and a royal blue one on the right. A fork stands upright between them, then tips over so the handle points to the blue one and slides across the table toward it. The blue one opens its eyes wide and both end with happy eyes and pulses.
